# Republic Airways

> Republic Airways is a regional airline and aviation career platform showcasing pilot training pathways, flight crew opportunities, and employee success stories.

Republic Airways operates through LIFT Academy for commercial pilot training and partners with major carriers like American, Delta, and United. The company emphasizes career development, work-life balance, and a supportive culture for aviation professionals at all levels.

- [Helicopter Pilot to Commercial Pilot](https://rjet.com/blog/a-veterans-aviation-journey): Eric Vetro's military to commercial aviation career transition story
